proof_scope: Static contract readback: required explanation fields, Excalidraw/SVG/default diagram boundary, debugger boundary, and end-of-work lifecycle are present; fault injection proves omissions are caught by the retained check.

cases.name: missing-strict-schema-wording-is-refused
command:
cd .. && T=$(mktemp -d) && cp SKILL.md $T/SKILL.md && python3 - <<'PY' $T/SKILL.md
from pathlib import Path
import sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('project.feature_explainer.v1','project.feature_explainer.vX'))
PY
if python3 - <<'PY' $T/SKILL.md
from pathlib import Path
import sys
t=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
for s in ['project.feature_explainer.v1','extra="forbid"','teleprompter_points','source_ranges','debugger_stops','ops-excalidraw','create-svg','End-of-work lifecycle']:
    assert s in t, s
PY
then exit 1; fi; echo BEST_PRACTICES_EXPLAIN_PROJECT_OMISSION_REFUSED
